method.controlled: Exact delivered RAF timestamps, 15/30/60/120 Hz; real module, real WebGL renderer, no copied physics model. This is not measured device FPS.
method.wall: Native browser RAF timestamps paced to at most approximately 15 Hz in real wall time; no accelerated/fabricated clock.
method.observation: HTTP response replaces only the existing test-hook comment. Pass-through wrappers count real simulation updates/render calls and observe state.
method.assistance: Only isolated Dash/platform tests place the player on an existing platform. No score/lives/invulnerability changes, no replacement collision code, and no skipped rendering.
method.limits: Headless desktop browser with software rendering; no physical phone/iPad or child playtest, no character visual certification, no complete route completion.
